# Edgecase Wait`n`nEdgecase Wait is a pay-per-use event-driven waiting service for autonomous agents.`n`n- Site: https://wait.edgecasesystems.com/`n- API: https://wait.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/`n- OpenAPI: https://wait.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/openapi.json`n- Offer: $0.01 per wait, one future JSON event, 60 seconds through 24 hours.`n- Delivery: bounded at-least-once callback delivery; deduplicate by wait_id.
